listings.name: OpenAI
listings.description_short: Creator of GPT models and the ChatGPT platform for AI development.
listings.description_long: OpenAI develops and deploys advanced AI models including GPT-4, DALL-E, and Whisper. Their API platform serves millions of developers building AI-powered applications across industries.

listings.name: Anthropic
listings.description_short: AI safety company building reliable, steerable AI systems.
listings.description_long: Anthropic builds Claude, a family of AI assistants focused on safety and helpfulness. Their Constitutional AI approach emphasizes building systems that are honest, harmless, and helpful.

listings.name: Google DeepMind
listings.description_short: Google's AI research lab behind Gemini and breakthrough research.
listings.description_long: Google DeepMind combines fundamental AI research with engineering to build advanced AI systems. Creators of Gemini, AlphaFold, and other groundbreaking AI technologies.

listings.name: Meta AI (LLaMA)
listings.description_short: Open-source AI models and research from Meta's AI division.
listings.description_long: Meta AI develops and open-sources the LLaMA family of large language models, making powerful AI accessible to researchers and developers worldwide.

listings.name: Hugging Face
listings.description_short: The open-source AI community hub for models, datasets, and apps.
listings.description_long: Hugging Face is the largest open-source machine learning community. Host to hundreds of thousands of models, datasets, and ML demos with tools like Transformers, Diffusers, and Spaces.

listings.name: Cursor
listings.description_short: AI-native code editor built for modern software development.
listings.description_long: Cursor is an AI-first code editor that integrates language models directly into the development workflow. Features include AI-powered code completion, inline editing, and codebase-aware chat.

listings.name: LangChain
listings.description_short: Framework for building applications powered by language models.
listings.description_long: LangChain provides tools and abstractions for building LLM-powered applications including RAG pipelines, agents, and chains. Supports Python and JavaScript with extensive integrations.

listings.name: Weights & Biases
listings.description_short: ML experiment tracking, model management, and dataset versioning.
listings.description_long: Weights & Biases provides a developer-first MLOps platform for experiment tracking, model evaluation, dataset versioning, and collaborative AI development workflows.

listings.name: Pinecone
listings.description_short: Managed vector database for AI-powered search and retrieval.
listings.description_long: Pinecone provides a fully managed vector database purpose-built for machine learning applications. Enables similarity search, recommendation systems, and RAG at scale.

listings.name: Replicate
listings.description_short: Run and deploy open-source AI models with a cloud API.
listings.description_long: Replicate lets you run open-source machine learning models in the cloud with a simple API. Deploy custom models or use thousands of community models for image generation, language, audio, and video.

listings.name: fast.ai
listings.description_short: Free deep learning courses and open-source library.
listings.description_long: fast.ai offers practical deep learning courses used by hundreds of thousands of students. Their open-source library makes deep learning accessible with best practices built in.

listings.name: Vertiv
listings.description_short: Critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions.
listings.description_long: Vertiv designs, builds, and services critical infrastructure for data centers, communication networks, and commercial/industrial environments. Products include power management, thermal management, and IT infrastructure.

listings.name: Schneider Electric
listings.description_short: Energy management and automation for data centers.
listings.description_long: Schneider Electric provides integrated solutions for data center power distribution, cooling, and management through their APC and EcoStruxure product lines.

listings.name: Upsite Technologies
listings.description_short: Airflow management and containment solutions for data centers.
listings.description_long: Upsite Technologies specializes in data center airflow management products including hot aisle containment, blanking panels, and grommets to improve cooling efficiency.

listings.name: Submer
listings.description_short: Immersion cooling technology for high-density compute.
listings.description_long: Submer develops precision immersion cooling solutions for data centers and edge deployments. Their SmartPod systems enable high-density computing with dramatically reduced energy consumption.

listings.name: GRC (Green Revolution Cooling)
listings.description_short: Single-phase immersion cooling for data center efficiency.
listings.description_long: GRC provides patented single-phase immersion cooling solutions that eliminate the need for chillers, CRACs, and raised floors while reducing cooling energy by up to 95%.

listings.name: Eaton
listings.description_short: Power management solutions for data center reliability.
listings.description_long: Eaton delivers power distribution, UPS systems, and energy storage solutions for data centers of all sizes. Their ePDU and UPS product lines are industry standards.

listings.name: Panduit
listings.description_short: Network infrastructure and cable management solutions.
listings.description_long: Panduit provides physical and network infrastructure solutions including structured cabling, cable management, and data center containment systems.

listings.name: Holder Construction
listings.description_short: Data center construction and design-build services.
listings.description_long: Holder Construction is a leading builder of mission critical facilities including hyperscale data centers, colocation facilities, and enterprise campuses across North America.

listings.name: Nlyte Software
listings.description_short: DCIM platform for data center asset and capacity management.
listings.description_long: Nlyte provides enterprise DCIM software for managing data center assets, capacity, power, and cooling. Integrates with ITSM and BMS platforms for holistic facility management.

listings.name: CoreWeave
listings.description_short: GPU-specialized cloud provider for AI and HPC workloads.
listings.description_long: CoreWeave operates GPU-accelerated cloud infrastructure purpose-built for AI training and inference, VFX rendering, and high-performance computing at scale.

listings.name: Lambda
listings.description_short: GPU cloud and on-prem infrastructure for deep learning.
listings.description_long: Lambda provides GPU cloud instances, on-prem servers, and workstations optimized for deep learning research and AI model training. Powers teams at top AI labs worldwide.

listings.name: Together AI
listings.description_short: Cloud platform for running and fine-tuning open-source AI models.
listings.description_long: Together AI provides a cloud platform optimized for running, fine-tuning, and training open-source AI models with high performance and cost efficiency.

listings.name: Equinix
listings.description_short: Global interconnection and colocation data center platform.
listings.description_long: Equinix operates 260+ data centers worldwide, providing colocation, interconnection, and digital infrastructure services. The world's largest data center REIT.

listings.name: Digital Realty
listings.description_short: Wholesale and colocation data center solutions worldwide.
listings.description_long: Digital Realty provides data center, colocation, and interconnection solutions across 50+ metros on six continents through their PlatformDIGITAL offering.

listings.name: QTS Realty Trust
listings.description_short: Hyperscale and hybrid colocation data center provider.
listings.description_long: QTS provides mega-scale custom data center solutions for hyperscale, hybrid colocation, and managed hosting customers across North America.

listings.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
listings.description_short: US federal framework for managing AI risks responsibly.
listings.description_long: The NIST AI Risk Management Framework provides voluntary guidance for organizations to manage AI risks, improve trustworthiness, and foster responsible AI development and use.

listings.name: The Green Grid
listings.description_short: Industry consortium advancing data center energy efficiency.
listings.description_long: The Green Grid is an open industry consortium dedicated to advancing energy efficiency in data centers and business computing ecosystems. Creators of the PUE metric.

listings.name: Data Center World
listings.description_short: Premier conference for data center professionals.
listings.description_long: Data Center World is the leading conference and expo for data center, facilities, and IT infrastructure professionals. Features education sessions, workshops, and an extensive exhibit floor.

listings.name: NVIDIA
listings.description_short: GPU computing platform powering AI and data center workloads.
listings.description_long: NVIDIA designs GPUs and systems-on-chip for AI training and inference, gaming, and professional visualization. Their CUDA ecosystem and data center GPUs are the backbone of modern AI.
